panel.screenshotHelp: Capture a Tab, Window, or Entire Screen and send it to the model. Typing into Ask first uses that text as the custom prompt; otherwise the model answers based on your current purpose.
panel.visibilityNotice: Browser cue is visible if you share your entire screen. Safe paths: (1) share only the meeting Tab/Window, then click Pop out — the answer card opens in a separate OS window the share won't include. (2) open cue on a phone, tablet, or second monitor that isn't shared. (3) for full invisibility on this machine, install the desktop app.
panel.poppedOutNote: Answer is now in the pop-out window. When sharing a single tab or app window, the pop-out is NOT captured.

context.title: Context
context.voiceSample: Voice sample (your own writing — used for tone)
context.voiceSampleHelp: Paste a few paragraphs you wrote yourself, or upload a document. cue uses this so its answers sound like you.

end.title: End this session?
end.alsoClearContext: Also clear pasted Job Description, Resume, and Role/Company
end.keysNote: API keys and voice sample are kept either way.

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.interviewHelp: Tight opener you can deliver verbatim, plus 2-4 supporting bullets grounded in resume/JD.
purpose.meetingHelp: Concise summary + a single insightful follow-up the user could say next.
purpose.studyHelp: Step-by-step explanation + a quick check question to reinforce.
